modules.title: 沙箱怎样限制不受信任代码的访问范围

items.title: 提供受限运行环境
items.text: 代码在操作系统沙箱、容器或虚拟机等受限环境中运行，只能看到被允许的文件、进程和网络资源。

items.title: 减少宿主机影响
items.text: 被投毒的依赖或错误命令即使破坏了沙箱，也更难直接读写宿主机的敏感文件。

items.title: 先限制输入边界
items.text: 只挂载必要目录、使用假数据并控制网络，比把生产凭证直接传入沙箱更安全。

modules.title: 沙箱不是权限审批
modules.text: 沙箱决定命令能访问什么，审批策略决定何时停下来询问，Read-only 只是其中一种写入边界。沙箱不能保护你主动挂载或注入的数据；如果网络也被允许，代码仍可能把这些数据发送出去。

lessonPractice.title: 让 AI 调试数据库时，哪种方案同时体现沙箱隔离和最小权限？

options.label: 在沙箱中运行，只挂载必要代码目录并连接测试或假数据
options.feedback: 对。受限环境和非生产数据共同减少宿主机、真实数据库和凭证暴露的影响。

options.label: 把生产数据库管理员账号放进沙箱，因为容器会自动保护所有数据
options.feedback: 沙箱不能让主动注入的生产凭证变得安全；代码仍可能使用或外传它们。

options.label: 只把权限模式设为 allow，就可以代替环境隔离
options.feedback: allow 是审批策略，不是技术隔离；自动允许命令反而可能扩大宿主机风险。

en.title: Which setup combines sandbox isolation with least privilege when the AI debugs a database?

options.label: Run in a sandbox with only the needed code mounted and a test or mock data connection
options.feedback: Correct. The restricted environment and non-production data reduce exposure of the host, real database, and credentials.

options.label: Pass production database admin credentials into the sandbox because containers protect all data automatically
options.feedback: A sandbox cannot make intentionally injected production credentials safe; code may still use or exfiltrate them.

options.label: Set permission mode to allow and use that instead of environment isolation
options.feedback: Allow is an approval policy, not technical isolation; auto-running commands can increase host risk.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请为测试代码准备隔离环境，只挂载项目的 code/ 目录，并使用假数据连接。先列出文件和网络边界，不要注入生产密钥或真实数据库凭证。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Prepare an isolated environment for the test code with only the project code/ directory mounted and a mock data connection. State the file and network boundaries; do not inject production keys or database credentials.

learning.assumes: You know that code or packages can execute local commands.
learning.outcome: You can distinguish technical isolation from permission approval and read-only controls, and keep sensitive data out of the sandbox.

modules.title: How does a sandbox isolate untrusted code from the host?

items.title: Provide a restricted runtime
items.text: Code runs under OS sandbox controls, in a container, or in a virtual machine with limited files, processes, and network access.

items.title: Reduce host impact
items.text: A poisoned dependency or bad command is less able to read or modify sensitive host files even if it damages the sandbox.

items.title: Limit inputs first
items.text: Mount only what is needed, use mock data, and control the network instead of passing production credentials into the sandbox.

modules.title: A sandbox is not permission approval
modules.text: The sandbox determines what commands can access, the approval policy determines when they pause to ask, and read-only is one possible write boundary. A sandbox cannot protect data you deliberately mount or inject; if network access is allowed, code may still send that data elsewhere.

distinctions.label: Permission Mode
distinctions.text: A {c:sandbox} enforces execution containment at the system boundary; a {c:permission-mode} dictates when to pause and prompt the user for approval.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: Prepare an isolated environment for the test code with only the project code/ directory mounted and a mock data connection. State the file and network boundaries; do not inject production keys or database credentials.
